adjudication.rationale: The diff shows that webex/lib/VideoApiAdapter.ts was modified to use refreshOAuthTokens() wrapper (lines 59-79), but unlike other integrations (zoom, office365calendar, google), it does NOT add parseRefreshTokenResponse() to handle the response. The code still uses `webexRefreshedTokenSchema.safeParse(responseBody)` at line 88 (not shown in diff but implied by the finding). When APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED is true, refreshOAuthTokens returns a minimal response with only access_token and expiry, but webexRefreshedTokenSchema likely requires Webex-specific fields (scope, token_type, refresh_token, refresh_token_expires_in). Other integrations like zoom (line 101) and office365calendar (line 256) were updated to use parseRefreshTokenResponse() which handles this case, but webex was not. This is a real bug where synced credentials would fail validation.
